P.name: Cell Division
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - The Secret Weapon:}} '''Zac''' gains increased percentage {{tip|size}} equal to {{as|{{fd|1.5}}% of his '''bonus''' health}}, capped at 35% increased size at {{as|{{fd|{{#expr:35/0.015 round 1}}{{recurring|3}}}} '''bonus''' health}}. '''Zac's''' size also reduces based on his {{as|'''missing''' health}}, down to 70% '''total''' size while at {{as|0% health}}.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Goo:}} Whenever '''Zac''' hits enemies with an {{tip|ability}}, he sheds a number of chunks of himself to a nearby location, landing towards nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} and lasting for 6 seconds.
* ''{{ai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for the initial hit, and 1 chunk if the second hits a different enemy
* ''{{ai|Unstable Matter|Zac}}'': 1 chunk if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Elastic Slingshot|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each enemy champion hit, with a minimum of 1 if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Let's Bounce!|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each bounce that hits at least one enemy
P.description3: Both '''Zac''' and enemy champions can interact with a chunk by being within 50 units of it: an enemy will destroy it, while '''Zac''' will consume it to {{tip|heal}} for {{as|{{pp|key=%|4 + (8-4)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of his '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Cell Division:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Zac''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for {{pp|8 to 4 for 5|1;6;10;13;17}} seconds, instantly restoring {{as|50% of his '''maximum''' health}} and becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. '''Zac''' then splits into four uncontrollable [[File:Cell_Division.png|20px|link=Zac#Pets]] ''[[Zac#Pets|bloblets]]'' away from his location, though stopping at terrain. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of the ''bloblets'' being {{tip|untargetable}}, they start moving toward '''Zac's''' location over the {{tt|remaining duration|Regardless of distance}}. Any damage the ''bloblets'' receive, excluding damage dealt in excess of each ''bloblet's'' {{as|'''total maximum''' health}}, is also echoed to '''Zac''' as {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. While in resurrection, '''Zac''' cannot take damage from sources other than the echoed damage from his ''bloblets''.
P.description5: After the duration, '''Zac''' is revived with {{as|{{tt|10 – 50%|Based on his bloblets' total remaining health. Reaches the maximum amount at full health on all bloblets}} '''maximum''' health}}. '''Zac''' will be {{tip|execute|executed}} once all bloblets are killed.
P.description6: ''See [[Zac#Pets|Pets]] for stats and details for bloblets.''

Q.name: Stretching Strikes
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' stretches his left arm in the target direction that catches the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Zac''' and the target for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 3% of '''Zac's''' '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% of '''Zac's''' '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: While the tether persists, '''Zac's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced by a second ''Stretching Strike'', empowering it to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time and gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' attack range}}. This attack triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but cannot {{tip|critically strike}} nor apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description3: If the two ''Stretching Strikes'' affect different targets, both are {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} and {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Estimated}} seconds while the {{tt|secondary target|Target hit by the empowered attack (or second Stretching Strike in this context)}} is dealt the initial {{as|magic damage}} and applied the same {{tip|slow}}. After a {{tt|{{fd|0.4}}-second delay|After the attack's cast time}}, '''Zac''' {{tt|displaces|Only move block, does not stun the target's actions (disables attacking and movement only)}} them toward each other over 300 units, though not through terrain.
Q.description4: If the two targets are within 700 units of each other, they are instead slammed together through the displacement. Upon impact of each other, both targets are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds and all enemies within the impact are dealt the initial {{as|magic damage}} and applied the same {{tip|slow}}.
Q.description5: ''Both Stretching Strikes (the cast and the empowered attack) {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Zac's''' basic attack timer. '''Zac''' is unable to move or attack while his left arm is in flight.''

W.name: Unstable Matter
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. The damage based on the target's max health ratio is capped at 200 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 80}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4 to 8}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|200+40 to 200+80}}}}
W.description2: '''Zac''' grants {{tip|ghost|ghosting}} to aggroed monsters hit for 5 seconds.
W.description3: ''Unstable Matter's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second whenever '''Zac''' collects a ''{{ai|Cell Division|Zac}}'' chunk.

E.name: Elastic Slingshot
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|4.5}} seconds to increase ''Elastic Slingshot's'' range over a cone in the target direction.
E.description2: ''Elastic Slingshot'' can be recast within the duration. If '''Zac''' {{tt|cancels|See notes}} the channel himself, or the charge completes without reactivation, 50% of ''Elastic Slingshot's'' {{sti|{{as|health cost}}}} and {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zac''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location within the boundaries of the cone. Upon landing, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to 1 second if ''Elastic Slingshot'' was charged for more than 1 second.

R.name: Let's Bounce!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' bounces after the cast time, then bounces 3 additional times each second over 3 seconds. Each bounce deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} over 1 second, and {{tip|slows}} them by 20% for the same duration. An enemy can be hit by multiple bounces, but ones beyond the first deal 50% damage to them and do not apply the {{tip|airborne|knock back}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage Per Hit|{{ap|120 to 260}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Reduced Damage Per Hit|{{ap|120/2 to 260/2}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|120*2.5 to 260*2.5}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
R.description2: '''Zac''' can move while ''Let's Bounce!'' is active, gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|type=duration|key=%|20 to 50 for 7|0 to 3}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, but becomes unable to declare {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}}'', and ''{{ai|Elastic Slingshot|Zac}}''. He also automatically consumes all ''{{ai|Cell Division|Zac|chunks}}'' within the bounce radius.
